messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Paging: P0 detected - /v1/generate high latency and error spike in us-west. 5xx rate > 4% over 2m, median latency ~1.8s, p95 ~6.2s. Pager: @alex oncall.

alex: On it. pulling recent logs and request traces. marking as live incident. mirror: https://grafana.internal/redwood/incidents/2455551234

mira: Noted — CS flagged two customers seeing timeouts and degraded UX. They reported retry storms.

jon: First quick mitigation: enable traffic-fallback to smaller model variant and lift autoscale pool by +2 nodes. That should cut token timeouts. Anyone seen a recent rollout to dedicated?

sam: I see a canary deploy for generator-v2 at 2455550600 that increased concurrency. Telemetry shows kv-cache hit ratio dropped from 92% -> 55% after that. Could be causing higher backend load.

alex: good catch. jon can you roll back canary? I'll bump capacity meanwhile.

jon: rolling back canary now. command: `deploy rollback generator-v2 --to=stable --reason="kv-cache regression"`

deploy-bot: ✅ rollback started (id: db-2455-regen). Expected 2m.

mira: I'll ping the affected customers with a short note. Sam, can you watch KV cache metrics and error rate?

sam: watching. kv-cache hit ratio recovering slowly. error-rate dropping from 4.3% -> 1.1% after rollback. latency p95 still a bit high ~3.5s.

alex: handing oncall to mira in 12m — I'll stay in thread for mitigation. devon you ok to add a temporary dashboard to track golden signals for this incident? quick panels only.

devon: Yep. I'll spin up a focused incident dashboard. Panels I'll add: p50/p95 latency (api + backend), 5xx rate, request rate, kv-cache hit ratio, queue depth, GPU utilization, model-queue time. Also links to traces/logs.

sam: Add a temporary alert tweak: suppress the current short-window 2m error alert and create a 5m sustained alert to reduce noise. We were paged 3x for the same spike earlier.

alex: +1 to suppressing flapping. Also add an annotation when deploys happen so post-incident we can correlate.

devon: Dashboard snippet I'll paste here for quick copy:

```json
{
  "title": "INCIDENT 2455551234 - live",
  "panels": [
    {"id":1, "type":"timeseries", "query":"rate(http_requests_total{path=\"/v1/generate\"}[1m])", "name":"req_rate"},
    {"id":2, "type":"timeseries", "query":"histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{path=\"/v1/generate\"}[1m])) by (le))", "name":"p95_latency"},
    {"id":3, "type":"timeseries", "query":"sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m]))", "name":"5xx_rate"},
    {"id":4, "type":"stat", "query":"kv_cache_hit_ratio"}
  ]
}
```

jon: perfect. For alerts: change `Alert:High5xx` from `threshold: 2% over 2m` to `3% over 5m` and add `for: 5m` and `dedup_labels: [route, region]` to reduce noise. Also add suppression rule during rollbacks/deploys.

mira: I'll create the incident ticket and owner list. Proposed post-mortem items: cause (cache regression from generator-v2), mitigation timeline, alert tuning, and a dedicated retrospective dashboard with drilldowns to traces and slow requests.

kevin: I'll own the retrospective dashboard after the incident. Plan: convert the temp incident dashboard into a stable retro dashboard with the following panels and links:
- Golden signals summary (error rate, latency, throughput)
- Per-model latency and failure breakdown
- Cache metrics (hit ratio, eviction rate)
- Deployment timeline overlay (deploys, rollbacks)
- Drilldowns: trace link -> jaeger, logs -> logql search with request_id
- Playbook snippet for toggling fallback routing and rollback commands

alex: assign PR to kevin for dashboard in infra-dashboards repo. Add a test to alert runbook: simulate kv-cache drop in staging.

devon: also add a Grafana drilldown target to the request flamegraph and to the trace UI: `https://traces.internal/trace/{{request_id}}`

sam: action items right now:
- devon: temp dashboard + annotations (in flight)
- jon: rollback done, monitor backend convergence (assigned)
- alex: capacity bump + customer comms (assigned)
- kevin: create retro dashboard PR after incident stabilized
- mira: post-incident ticket and CS follow-up

mira: handoff done to kevin for postmortem. alex, please update timeline in the ticket with exact timestamps.

alex: will do. initial impact window: 2455550600 -> 2455551600 UTC.

devon: Dashboard URL: https://grafana.internal/d/incident-temp/incident-2455551234 (creating panels now) :wrench:

sam: error-rate back to 0.4%, p95 ~900ms, kv-cache hit ratio 89% — looks like rollback + scale helped.

kevin: I'll open the PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-dashboards/pull/482 (WIP) and add the drilldowns and alert changes as part of the retro.

alex: nice work team. Post-incident followups: 1) formal alert tuning (change windows & dedupe), 2) permanent retro dashboard, 3) staging test for cache regression, 4) fix canary deploy gating. I'll create tasks in the incident ticket.

mira: closing the live mitigation — will wait 30m to confirm stability then file for incident closure. cc @devops :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 2455551234 marked as mitigated (initial mitigation) at 2455551700.

kevin: after fragging the temp panels into the repo, I'll add README notes for drilldowns and runbook snippets.

alex: thanks everyone. will do final handoff summary in the ticket and link the dashboard/PR.

mira: +1 thanks.
